role: Free functions for sharing from UIKit: write the recap card as a named PNG to tmp, find the topmost presenter, and present a UIActivityViewController with an iPad popover anchor whose completion deletes a recap PNG or a file written for that one share (presentFileShareSheet), shared or cancelled.
toplevel: Global free functions only; callers DashboardV2View+Chips.swift, RecoveryScoreDetailView+Panels.swift, PDFPreviewView.Coordinator.shareAction (presentShareSheet) and FileShareButton, ExportDataView, FitnessTabView (presentFileShareSheet).

units.does: Creates tmp/RecapShare/ and writes the image PNG there as emuqu-<yyyy-MM-dd>-score-<score>.png (POSIX Gregorian date), returning that URL (presentShareSheet deletes it when the sheet closes); if pngData is nil, or the directory create or write throws (logged by attempt), returns the UIImage itself.
Finds the foreground-active UIWindowScene, takes the key window's root (or first window's), and walks presentedViewController while not being dismissed; returns nil when no active scene/root.

branches.cond: foreground-active UIWindowScene found and a root VC exists

branches.effect: use it; else ?? first window's root

branches.cond: presented VC exists and is not being dismissed
branches.effect: descend; else stop and return current

units.does: The item as a file URL when it is a URL directly inside recapShareDirectory (a recap PNG); nil otherwise (e.g. a PDF the preview still shows).
Returns a share-sheet completion that calls shareSheetClosed(removing: file, onClosed:).

The share sheet closed: deletes file, when given (a failed delete is logged by attempt 'share.file.remove'), then runs onClosed on the main actor (MainActor.assumeIsolated: UIKit calls the completion on the main thread).

Creates a UIActivityViewController for one item; when the item is a recap PNG (recapShareFile) sets a completion that deletes it once the sheet closes (shared or cancelled); presents it through presentActivitySheet (popover anchored to the presenter's view centre on iPad).

branches.cond: item is not a recap PNG

units.does: Shares a file written for this one share: a UIActivityViewController over the file (wrapped in ShareFileItem when a title is given, so the sheet's header shows the title and icon), whose completion deletes the file once the sheet closes, shared or cancelled, then runs onClosed; presented through presentActivitySheet.
writes: file:the shared file (deleted when the sheet closes)

branches.effect: shares the bare file URL (header shows the file name)

units.does: Anchors the activity sheet's popover to the presenter's view centre with no arrow when one exists (iPad), and presents it from the presenter.
